landing.seo.title: Write, build worlds and read stories | Literary Universe
landing.seo.description: Write and publish stories, build fictional worlds, and read fiction on Literary Universe. Connect your lore to chapters and grow a community around your work.
landing.hero.description: Write the story. Build the world behind it. Publish it where readers can explore every detail.
landing.hero.freeNote: Free to start. Upgrade when you need more room.
landing.bridge.first.body: A universe is a shared world: its encyclopedia, its stories, comics and audiobooks, its forum and its fans. Literary Universe puts all of it in one place, from first draft to living fandom.
landing.journey.intro: Writing a story is only the beginning. Literary Universe helps authors build the world around their stories, connect with readers, and turn creative work into a long-term author presence.
landing.journey.summit.alt: Lunea and Luca begin a journey toward a mountain summit
landing.journey.summit.caption: Every world begins with an idea.
landing.journey.universe.title: Create Universe
landing.journey.universe.body: Keep characters, places, factions, history, magic and technology in one encyclopedia. Link entries to each other, draw them as a graph, and invent your own calendar.
landing.journey.stories.title: Create stories
landing.journey.stories.body: Write chapters in a rich editor with autosave, revision history and offline drafts. Schedule releases, then publish stories, comics or audiobooks.
landing.journey.lore.title: Connect lore to stories
landing.journey.lore.body: Link a name in your text to its encyclopedia entry. Readers open it without leaving the chapter, and facts can stay hidden until the story reveals them.
landing.journey.audience.title: Grow your audience
landing.journey.audience.body: Build reader communities through author profiles, blogs, forums, fan clubs, and discussion spaces.
landing.journey.collaborate.title: Collaborate with others
landing.journey.collaborate.body: Invite co-authors, beta readers, translators and artists. Share drafts, comment on revisions, and credit everyone who worked on the story.
landing.journey.monetize.title: Monetize your work
landing.journey.monetize.body: Sell chapters, story arcs or whole books. Set prices in supported currencies, leave the opening chapters free, and keep 70% to 90% of each sale.
landing.readers.intro: Read the story, then open the world behind it. Every name, place and faction is a tap away.
landing.readers.keyart.alt: Lunea reading a book and Luca with a tablet, surrounded by their story worlds
landing.readers.comfort.label: Made for comfortable reading
landing.readers.connected.title: Connected Story Reader
landing.readers.connected.body: When a story links to encyclopedia entries, you can look up characters, places, factions and lore without leaving the chapter. Details stay spoiler-safe: an entry can hold facts back until you reach the chapter that reveals them.
landing.readers.discovery.title: Story Discovery
landing.readers.discovery.body: Find stories by genre, universe, author, language, age rating and license. Recommendations can be personal, from the community, or by date. You can hide stories made with AI.
landing.readers.notes.title: Reader Notes
landing.readers.notes.body: Keep private notes on stories, chapters and encyclopedia entries. They all land in one searchable notes library.
landing.readers.pages.title: Universe Pages
landing.readers.pages.body: Every universe has a public page with its stories, comics, lore, contributors and forum.
landing.readers.lists.title: Reading Lists
landing.readers.lists.body: Save stories, build public or private reading lists, and pick up where you stopped. Your library even has a 3D bookshelf.
landing.readers.community.title: Community Around Stories
landing.readers.community.body: Comment on chapters, join forums around a universe, follow authors and their blogs, and meet other fans in groups and at events.
landing.authors.eyebrow: Your work. Your worlds. Your readers.
landing.authors.intro: Literary Universe helps writers create a long-term home for their work, their worlds, and their readers.
landing.authors.profile.title: Author Profile
landing.authors.profile.body: A public page with your works, stats and activity, plus a verified badge. Build a resume and share it with publishers through a private link.
landing.authors.fanClubs.title: Fan Clubs
landing.authors.fanClubs.body: Offer membership tiers with perks. Members get early access to new chapters, and you can reward them with access to a story.
landing.authors.forums.title: Forums
landing.authors.forums.body: Open a forum on your universe, with categories, access rules and a thread that starts itself with every new chapter.
landing.authors.groups.title: Groups
landing.authors.groups.body: Build or join communities around genres, writing interests, fandoms, and creative projects.
landing.authors.organizations.title: Organizations
landing.authors.organizations.body: Publishers, writing groups, schools and teams get shared workshops, member roles, courses and a fan club of their own.
landing.authors.statistics.title: Statistics
landing.authors.statistics.body: See who reads, how far they get and how they found you. Break it down by chapter, by language and by day of the week.
landing.future.intro: Share a private resume link with publishers, keep Thema and ONIX details ready for shops and libraries, and agree licenses on the platform. Publisher tools and more ways to distribute are on the way.
landing.future.art.alt: Lunea and Luca creating a universe of stories together
landing.final.intro: Whether you are writing your first story, managing a complex saga, or looking for your next fictional world to explore, Literary Universe gives you a place to create, publish, discover, and grow.
landing.formats.intro: Prose, manga, webtoons and audiobooks live in the same universe. So do their translations.
landing.formats.comics.title: Comics and manga
landing.formats.comics.body: Draw western comics, manga or vertical webtoons on layered pages. Readers tap a panel to open the encyclopedia.
landing.formats.audio.title: Audiobooks
landing.formats.audio.body: Upload a recording for each chapter, or link audio hosted elsewhere. Listeners can download it and keep going offline.
landing.formats.translation.title: Translation
landing.formats.translation.body: Translate side by side with the original. Invite translators, then give each language its own price and its own stats.
landing.formats.languages.title: Many languages
landing.formats.languages.body: The site speaks many languages, with careful Japanese typography and support for scripts that read right to left.
landing.money.title.em: Keep most of what it earns.
landing.money.intro: No subscriber threshold, no coins to buy, no balance that expires. Readers pay the price on the page, and you choose what to sell.
landing.money.share.body: of each sale is yours before payment processing: 90% under an exclusive license, 70% under a non-exclusive one.
landing.money.sell.body: Sell what suits the story. Leave the opening chapters free, set prices in supported currencies, or publish under Creative Commons.
landing.money.club.body: Offer tiers with perks, early access to new chapters, and access to a story as a reward.
landing.money.split.body: Set revenue splits for co-authors, artists and narrators. Each person connects Stripe to receive their share.
landing.rights.intro: Pick how others may use your work, protect what you sell, and decide what part AI plays.
landing.rights.copyright.title: You keep your copyright
landing.rights.copyright.body: Choose a license for each work with a step-by-step chooser, from Creative Commons to exclusive. Your sales data is yours too.
landing.rights.protect.title: Protect what you sell
landing.rights.protect.body: Paid text is harder to copy or print. Comic pages can carry a quiet watermark that points to the reader. If you find a copy of your work, report it from the page.
landing.rights.ai.title: AI, if you want it
landing.rights.ai.body: An optional assistant knows your own story and universe. It answers questions and proofreads, and you can bring your own AI account. Label works made with AI, and choose whether AI crawlers may learn from yours.
landing.more.fan.title: Fan works
landing.more.fan.body: Let fans write fan fiction and send fan art inside your universe, under your rules.
landing.more.blogs.title: Blogs
landing.more.blogs.body: Run a blog for yourself, your universe, a group or an organization, with themes, pages and menus.
landing.more.events.title: Events
landing.more.events.body: Host events in person, online or both. Free or paid, once or on repeat.
landing.more.courses.title: Courses
landing.more.courses.body: Organizations can teach with lessons, reading assignments and quizzes.
landing.more.way.title: The Way of the Author
landing.more.way.body: Author levels with clear next steps, plus tracks by genre.
landing.more.challenges.title: Writing challenges
landing.more.challenges.body: Set word goals, run sprints with a timer, and keep a diary with streaks.
landing.more.offline.title: Offline writing
landing.more.offline.body: Keep writing chapters, notes and your diary without internet. They sync when you are back.
landing.more.ebooks.title: Ebooks and shops
landing.more.ebooks.body: Download EPUB, send a story to Kindle, or link readers to the shop where your book is sold.
landing.faq.free.a: Yes. The free plan lets you create universes and stories, translate, write fan fiction, run a fan club and sell your work. It has limits, such as the number of encyclopedia entries. Paid plans add more encyclopedia room, blogs, forums and advanced statistics.
landing.faq.rights.a: Yes. You keep your copyright and choose a license for each work. When you sell, the platform fee is 10% under an exclusive license and 30% under a non-exclusive one.
landing.faq.ai.q: Do I have to use AI?
landing.faq.ai.a: No. The assistant is optional and answers questions about your own story and universe. Works made with AI carry a label, readers can hide them, and you decide whether AI crawlers may learn from your work.
landing.faq.languages.q: Can I publish in more than one language?
landing.faq.languages.a: Yes. Translate side by side with the original, invite translators, and sell each language at its own price.
landing.faq.formats.q: Can I make comics or audiobooks?
landing.faq.formats.a: Yes. Create western comics, manga or webtoons, or add audio to each chapter. Team roles and revenue splits are built in.
